assessment_summary: Individual assignment: The individual assignment consists of multiple components that may include the completion of tasks with SAP and a written report.

Group project: You must demonstrate an information infrastructure which explains the role of enterprise systems within that infrastructure, discusses organisational and change management issues, and examines the effect of new technological trends.
Case presentation: Each group is scheduled for a 10-minute case presentation during different weeks. The goal of these presentations is to help the class better understand the case background.
Final exam: This is a closed-book exam and will assess your ability to demonstrate your understanding of all material covered in the unit of study.
Detailed information for each assessment can be found on Canvas.

items.label: Overview paragraph 1
items.text: The unit provides an overall introduction to the different components of digital information infrastructures in organisational contexts. This includes organisational enterprise systems architecture, legacy systems, enterprise systems, cloud infrastructure and enabling technologies such as blockchain, internet of things, or web services. Strategic managerial issues that arise from the implementation, use, and security management of information infrastructures and enterprise systems are also covered. The unit utilises a combination of practical sessions with Enterprise Systems, such as SAP, and case study analyses to build a deep understanding of relevant topics.

items.label: Learning outcome 1
items.text: LO1. explore the strategic managerial issues that arise from the implementation and use of enterprise systems as a means of integrating data and standardising processes

items.label: Learning outcome 2
items.text: LO2. use an example enterprise system to gain hands-on competency in supporting key business processes

items.label: Learning outcome 3
items.text: LO3. provide an overview of an enterprise system implementation solution which addresses key processes, data and organisational structures, and explain the reasons behind the solution

items.label: Learning outcome 4
items.text: LO4. evaluate the place of enterprise systems in broader digital information infrastructure.

items.label: Learning outcome 5
items.text: LO5. evaluate in a critical manner the technical trends which may impact on future enterprise systems use

items.label: Learning outcome 6
items.text: LO6. present ideas and arguments effectively, deliver a comprehensive and integrated enterprise information infrastructure that reflects a collective effort from a professional project team

items.label: Learning outcome 7
items.text: LO7. apply the principles of IT resources management to effectively solve real-world problems.

items.label: Final Exam Closed book exam
